edge_explainer: The screen scores Hunting cheap on EV/EBIT 13.0x, an 11% free-cash-flow yield and 1.04x book. All three fail primary verification. (1) The EV/EBIT figure is a mixed-basis artifact; on the company's own adjusted operating result it is 10.3x — but Hunting's tax-and-minority take is about 36% of adjusted pre-tax profit, so that becomes a 17.7x trailing (about 14.7x forward) price/earnings multiple. EV/EBIT cheapness on a high-tax business systematically overstates equity cheapness. (2) The 11% cash yield is a working-capital release: 2025 free cash flow of $96.6m included an $18.0m working-capital inflow (2024: $53.3m) that the annual report attributes to unwinding the bank-acceptance drafts on the completed $231m Kuwait Oil Company orders, plus $9.9m of property disposal proceeds. Management's own through-cycle conversion target of 50% of EBITDA implies about $75m, or 8.5%. The high cash yield and the growth case are mutually exclusive — rebuilding the order book consumes the working capital that produced the yield, which is already visible in the swing to net borrowings by June 2026. (3) 1.0x book is the right price for a business earning a 10% return on capital employed against a roughly 10% cost of capital; the company's own 15% target is a 2030 goal, and book value per the five-year table has gone nowhere ($871m in 2021 to $885m in 2025). Separately, the marketed story that Hunting is now a subsea/international business and therefore less exposed to US onshore is refuted by the segment disclosure: North America plus Hunting Titan rose from 49.7% to 60.6% of group EBITDA in 2025, while both growth legs went backwards on profit (Subsea EBITDA -22%, Asia Pacific -10%) and the OCTG order book fell 69%. Subsea is 34% of the order book but only 17% of profit. The order book overall is $358m against $565m two years ago and covers only 30% of a revenue year. Finally, the whole of 2026's guided growth is unbanked: first-half EBITDA of $62m against a $145-155m full-year guide requires a second half of $83-93m. Expected fair value 442.5p against 448.5p live is a negative edge before 55.5bp of entry friction. Execution is excellent — 11bp touch, $313k of tradeable size a day, the most liquid line in this band — and worth nothing without a thesis.
